item: P2.3 held-out source preparation, separate from P2.2; not yet built/evaluated

separation.policy: Do not disclose source/oracles/outputs to reconstruction tuners or change passes in response to these held-out cases. If this policy is breached, mark contaminated and retire as held-out; do not silently rename/reselect favorable programs.

selected_functions.name: heldout_roll
selected_functions.category: byte processing, modular rotation recurrence, count/terminator exits
selected_functions.review_question: Describe the packed result and both loop stop conditions.

selected_functions.name: heldout_runs
selected_functions.category: bounded run-length encoding, capacity failure, ordered memory writes
selected_functions.review_question: Describe the output format, maximum run length and insufficient-capacity behavior.

selected_functions.name: heldout_merge
selected_functions.category: stable two-source merge with exhaustion tails
selected_functions.review_question: Describe tie ordering, exhaustion behavior and output capacity contract.

selected_functions.name: heldout_saturate
selected_functions.category: unsigned narrow storage, saturating arithmetic, mutation count
selected_functions.review_question: Describe the value bound, stores and returned count.

selected_functions.name: heldout_weighted
selected_functions.category: filtered FP accumulation and zero-denominator branch
selected_functions.review_question: Describe filtering, normalization and empty-effective-input return.

valid_input_contract: All arrays cover stated counts/capacities; null only where count is zero and no read occurs.
heldout_runs input/output nonoverlapping; capacity is available output bytes.
heldout_merge inputs sorted ascending, output nonoverlapping, left_count+right_count fits u32 and output allocation.
FP ordinary finite values/default rounding; exclude cases overflowing/underflowing sums or products and exceptional/trapping environments.
equal_access: Identical binary bytes and selected VA per pair, no source/debug sidecars/prototypes/annotation injection. Unsupported cells retained explicitly.

blind_review_protocol.source_and_tool_labels: Hidden from readability reviewers; independent source-derived answer key held separately from paired output sheets.
blind_review_protocol.paired_order: Assign randomized A/B tool ordering after raw outputs exist; retain seed/mapping separately and do not show to reviewer.
blind_review_protocol.rubric: For each dimension score 0 unusable/misleading, 1 severe impediments, 2 mixed/partly recoverable, 3 clear with minor impediments, 4 clear and faithful to visible task. No missing-output score substitutes for coverage reporting.
blind_review_protocol.reporting: Retain per-case answers/scores and disagreements; separate readability from correctness and usable coverage; text length is diagnostic only.

status: Source/selection frozen; no decompiler run, reviewer score, semantic correctness or comparative win claimed.
